claims.text: 45 third-year students participated in the C-START industry interaction programme on July 18, 2026.
Feedback collected from participants was overwhelmingly positive, with 92% rating the event as 'very useful' for career preparation.
Mr. Rajesh Pillai, Chief Technology Officer, Nimbus Technologies, delivered the keynote address.
The C-START industry interaction programme was conducted in collaboration with three local software companies: Vertex Software and BlueLeaf Systems.
The event was held from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM in the department seminar hall.

claims.text: C-START, an industry interaction programme aimed at connecting final-year and third-year students with the software industry, was held on July 18, 2026.

Forty-five third-year students participated in the C-START event, which featured a keynote address by Mr. Rajesh Pillai, CTO of Nimbus Technologies, and a panel discussion with representatives from Vertex Software and BlueLeaf Systems.
The event was deemed overwhelmingly positive with 92% rating the event as 'very useful' for career preparation.
